title: Тайная гостья за столиком и интервью Елены  (The Mystery Guest at the Table and Elena's Interview)

segments.t: In the dining room, Nastya grows jealous when she sees a well-dressed woman smiling at Kostya behind the bar, only to march over and discover that the guest is her own mother, Svetlana. Meanwhile in the kitchen, Chef Barinov is furious when he sees a two-page magazine feature praising rival chef Elena.
Пойдемте они вечером в кино.
Я бы так и сказала.
Спина, Кость, пойдем в кино.
Настя, я вообще-то верность тебе храню.
Она глазки мне строит.
А я не обращаю внимания.
Сейчас я с ней поговорю.
Мам, что ты здесь делаешь?
Не, ведь ты видел это, а?
Еще интервью на две страницы.
Почему она, а не ты?
В этом вопросе тебе полностью верю.
Пока кто-то тут сидит и умничает.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
Пойдемте они вечером в кино.
'Let us go to the movies together tonight.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'come on' and finishing on 'the cinema'. Nastya answers right away.
Я бы так и сказала.
'That is exactly what I would have said.' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'to say' without extra filler words.
Спина, Кость, пойдем в кино.
'Behind your back, Kostya, let us go to the movies.' The meaning hinges on 'back' working together with 'the cinema' in spoken Russian.
Настя, я вообще-то верность тебе храню.
'Nastya, I am actually staying completely faithful to you.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Nastya' and finishing on 'to keep'. Kostya answers right away.
Она глазки мне строит.
'She keeps making eyes at me.' Kostya anchors the line on 'she', while 'to build' completes the thought.
А я не обращаю внимания.
'And I am paying no attention to her at all.' Nastya anchors the line on 'and', while 'attention' completes the thought.
Сейчас я с ней поговорю.
'I am going to go have a word with her right now.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'any minute' before landing on 'I'll talk'. Nastya answers right away.
Мам, что ты здесь делаешь?
'Mom, what are you doing here?' The grammar packs 'Mum' and 'are you doing' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Не, ведь ты видел это, а?
'No, Vitya, have you seen this, huh?' Kostya anchors the line on 'not', while 'and' completes the thought.
Еще интервью на две страницы.
'A two-page interview on top of that.' Nastya brings out the contrast between 'else' and 'interview' in a few short words. Kostya answers right away.
Почему она, а не ты?
'Why did they pick her instead of you?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'why' before landing on 'you'.
В этом вопросе тебе полностью верю.
'On that question I trust you completely.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'that' before landing on 'believe'.
Пока кто-то тут сидит и умничает.
'While somebody sits around here acting smart.' Kostya anchors the line on 'for now', while 'to act smart' completes the thought. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
